title: Firmware Attacks on Network Edge Devices | PJ Networks
body:
In late 2024 and through 2025, a string of sophisticated attacks targeting network edge devices — firewalls, VPN gateways, and SD-WAN appliances — moved from theoretical risk to documented reality. Threat actors, including state-sponsored groups, have been exploiting zero-day vulnerabilities in edge devices not simply to gain entry, but to persist within firmware and survive factory resets. For Indian enterprise IT leaders, this is no longer a headline from abroad. As CERT-In advisories and [...] Firmware-level attacks on edge devices represent a maturation of the threat landscape that demands a corresponding maturation in defensive operations. Patching remains the single most important control — the vast majority of successful exploits target known, patched vulnerabilities that have not yet been applied. But patching alone does not address the detection gap that allows firmware implants to persist unnoticed, nor the response gap that makes CERT-In’s 6-hour reporting window challenging [...] PJ Networks helps Indian enterprises deploy and operate exactly this kind of layered control set, anchored by FortiGate/Fortinet platforms and the PrahiX Ora unified SecOps stack.
